body:
The sorting migration still needs connected producer and consumer repairs.
PR #780 remains at `e14407cc494615f0b16522fb7aa7672a3589a3c3`; the local
partial implementation has not been pushed or validated.

Current main is `990430b77a9f63548ffcb642074185f61ddb3322`, including merged
#774 and newer garment producers. It has been fetched for source inspection.
Its delta changes 29 paths in the previously pinned dispatch inventory and
introduces additional connected producer paths.

Open work includes canonical #779 dispatch/byte integration, semantic count
propagation, native address products, folded-dispatch padding, and coherent
resource/count and cache state. The audit includes direct metal-bake fixture
admission, cut-point construction before the underlayer plan, and unchanged
sorting consumers. The operations lens and the complete initial thirteen-lens
coverage of the current graph remain unfinished; earlier selected-scope
verdicts are not clearance.

Claimed shared-function edits still require the
[explicit ownership agreement](https://github.com/adventure-simulator-group/fabelgeist/pull/774#issuecomment-6354068841).
Source repairs remain frozen. No new tests, cases, helpers or assertions have
been added. No local project checks or new hosted CI request have been run.

Final independent Code, Rule and Comment Reviews and required hosted checks
must pass on the same final pushed revision. This PR is not ready to merge.
